info.title: wcom-pr-validation
info.description: Azure DevOps PR validation tool for .NET projects

options.name: --pr
options.description:
Pull request ID (overrides
SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_PULLREQUESTID environment
variable)

options.name: --pat
options.description:
Personal Access Token for Azure DevOps
(overrides AZDO_PAT environment variable)

options.name: --branch
options.description:
Source branch name (overrides
SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_SOURCEBRANCH environment
after validation for debugging purposes

options.name: --keep-repo
options.description:
Keep the cloned repository directory (pr-src)
after validation for debugging purposes

options.name: --format
options.description:
Run dotnet format on the repository and
commit any changes back to the PR

options.name: --target-dir
options.description:
Target directory where the cloned repository
(pr-src) should be placed (default: 'pr-src'
in current directory)

options.name: --exclude-branch-prefix
options.description:
Skip validation when the source branch name
starts with this prefix (repeatable).
Default: renovate/ when not specified
